decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display is a low-cost, core-adjacent catalog variant that fits existing cardboard capacity. Despite the 2022 energy and paper cost pressure, it gives no clear shortfall against aspiration that would justify dropping it.

The pegboard-back display serves a distinct hook-merchandise niche on existing lines, but its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 and the cost squeeze make its future uncertain, so it is kept for now with elevated risk.
The eighth-pallet format complements the quarter-pallet range for small placements at little incremental cost, so the remaining slack still justifies carrying it.

The wooden pallet departs from the cardboard core and has not shown up on the website since 2018, and the 2022 cost shortfall triggers problemistic search that favors moving its resources back to the core cardboard business.
